t2i_prompt: A 1440 px wide desktop web section as a flat straight-on UI mockup on deep navy. Top left: a small mono uppercase eyebrow, a large light-weight sans headline and a short light intro. Across the width, five stops each with a large mono numeral 01-05, a light sans title and two small mono uppercase lines for <CONTENT>. One continuous double-line steel-blue pipe enters from the left edge and weaves under, over and around the stops with rounded elbows, with fine P&ID valve symbols at the bends. Flat blueprint line art, no shading, no cards, generous empty navy.
signature_idea: The document list is strung on one pipe: a single steel-blue double line with valves threads past every numbered deliverable.
strengths: one clear visual idea that turns a plain list into a process line
very close to brand: navy, one steel-blue accent, light headline, mono numerals
spacious and calm; text is legible
easy to build as an SVG path behind a five-column grid with a draw-on animation
weaknesses: pipe route is arbitrary: the bends and loop do not mean anything about the documents
valves are decorative, not tied to any step
item 05 says 'PVC part certificates' (wrong material; offer is PP)
pipe crosses close to text at 02 and 04, tight on smaller widths
intro copy is generic marketing tone
brand_fit_why: Navy ground, single steel-blue accent pipe, light sans headline, mono numerals and hairline P&ID art match the brand book closely.
